speaker: Serra
text: I’m going to tell you something unpleasant. On the road, you were right to help. You were also one step from getting someone else hurt.

speaker: Kai
text: I noticed you were there to tell me.

speaker: Serra
text: I was there because someone needed a shield and a clear way out. Those are not the same thing as a glorious charge.

speaker: Serra
text: Tidemark teaches you to stand when running would be easier, and to think before a choice becomes someone else’s injury.

speaker: Kai
text: Sounds like rules. A lot of rules.

speaker: Serra
text: Yes. Sometimes they save lives. Sometimes they need challenging. I am still learning the difference.

speaker: Serra
text: If you come to Tidemark, I will expect you to challenge me when I’m wrong. And I will expect you to listen when I’m right.
